question: Is there a free multifamily market report for San Antonio?
answer:
Yes — several brokerages and data firms publish free quarterly (or monthly) multifamily reports for San Antonio, no paywall required:

- **Yardi Matrix** – publishes a monthly San Antonio multifamily report (rent trends, occupancy, supply pipeline). Latest: rents flat around $1,232/unit, down ~2.8% YoY.
- **Colliers** – quarterly San Antonio multifamily report; Q2 2026 showed 1,731 units delivered YTD, occupancy up to 93.1%, and 12 straight quarters of shrinking construction pipeline.
- **Marcus & Millichap / Institutional Property Advisors (IPA)** – their annual/quarterly investment forecast report; projects San Antonio to rank #2 nationally in employment growth for 2026.
- **Berkadia** – quarterly research report (Q1 2026 edition covers demographic and rent trends).
- **Northmarq** – periodic insights pieces specifically on San Antonio supply/deliveries; projecting just 2,600 new units in 2026, a 63% drop from 2025.
- **MMG Real Estate Advisors** – annual San Antonio forecast report.
- **MetroSgnl** – free market-intelligence snapshot; currently scoring San Antonio 4.1/10 ("Caution") with -1.8% YoY rent growth and 9.1% vacancy (note this conflicts somewhat with other sources — different firms define/calculate vacancy differently, e.g., Neiboroughly cites 15.8% vacancy, so treat any single number as approximate and check methodology).
- **SARents (Proudly Local)** – a locally focused rental market report if you want more of a renter/small-landlord angle rather than institutional investment data.

All of these are free with just an email/contact form in most cases (Yardi Matrix, Colliers, Berkadia, Marcus & Millichap typically just require registering). If you want something more granular (submarket-level, specific property class, rent comps), CBRE and RealPage also cover San Antonio but their detailed reports are usually gated behind a sales contact rather than a free download — worth asking your account rep if you already work with either.
